test_inputs.explanation: The agent navigated to the Magento admin category page (admin/catalog_category). In Magento the top-level parent is typically 'Default Category', so that was used as the parent. The subcategory name and url_key are taken from the example pattern shown in the tool schema ('Bot Subcategory Created by Tool' / 'bot-subcategory-tool'). The agent visited the admin UI repeatedly, so standard visible options 'Yes' were used for 'Is Active' and 'Include in Navigation Menu', and the common scope 'All Store Views' was selected for Store View.
